name: State-based Execution
instructions:
Execution state for this project is a set of durable notes, restored between steps.
Conversation history is trimmed automatically; never rely on it to carry information. Anything needed later belongs in the state.

The state holds these keys:

- `decisions` (array) — Choices made and the reason for each
- `experiment` (object) — The running measurement: arms, numbers, what would invalidate it
- `findings` (array) — What was learned, especially what contradicted an earlier belief
- `goal` (string) — What this repository's work is trying to achieve, in one sentence
- `invariants` (array) — Facts a future change must not break, and why they hold
- `open` (array) — Questions still unanswered, and why each matters
- `process` (array) — How this project is worked: state, tooling, committing
- `shipped` (array) — What is done and verified, with the evidence
- `todo` (array) — What is left to do
- `todo_ongoing` (array) — Work currently in flight

A patch is sparse: a key it does not mention keeps its current value. An array is replaced whole rather than appended to, so adding one item means sending the whole list. A nested object merges recursively. A key set to null is deleted.
